versions.name: Buck Hill Scout Camp
versions.summary: A year-round Narragansett Council short-term camping property in Pascoag, Rhode Island, with tent sites, waterfront campsites on Wakefield Pond, cabins, and a large lodge for troop and family camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Narragansett Council camps listing (narragansettbsa.org), which lists Buck Hill Scout Camp as one of its six current weekend-camping properties. The source's rarrtl-buck-hill property URL is dead; the current camp page is used instead. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council camps page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
